column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules for staging (infra/security/zap-baseline.sh, Section 9 DAST).
# ZAP's -c format: rule id, action, (rule name), why. Tabs separate the fields.
# IGNORE  an accepted alert; the last field says why. Never fails the job.
# FAIL    a protection Atlas and Gateway guarantee on every page; any alert fails the job.
# WARN    reported in the job summary. Rules not listed are WARN, except that any High alert fails
#         unless its rule is ignored here (infra/security/src/zap.ts).
# Prepared 2026-10-21 (A94) before the first staging run, which waits on the owner's
# VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET. Review every WARN in the first run's summary and record each
# decision here: fix it, or IGNORE it with the reason.
